title: tooling(pm): fleet-roster.mjs imports the pm:mailbox constants from mailbox-open.mjs instead of declaring its own
body:
Filing gate: ② seat follow-up from two landed cards — #25416 (PR #25440, `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs`) and #25417 (PR #25433, `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`), reported by #25416's card thread at handback. Reader: the `domain:devx` seat 1 (#6023), as an in-seat S change. Dedup: none open; this is the duplicate declaration the two PRs left by landing in parallel. Session: `cse_01LKHDniRQSWjRJyDtacwpEd`.

## One-sentence problem

`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs:110-112` declares its own `MAILBOX_LABEL`, `LEDGER_EXCLUSION` and `MAILBOX_BRANCH_PREFIX`. `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` exports the same three as the one declaration ledger readers import ("exported below for the readers to import, never retyped"). Two spellings can drift.

## Change

- `fleet-roster.mjs` imports `MAILBOX_LABEL`, `LEDGER_EXCLUSION` and `MAILBOX_BRANCH_PREFIX` (or `mailboxBranch`) from `./mailbox-open.mjs` and deletes its local declarations. It re-exports them only if a caller imports them from `fleet-roster.mjs` today; grep first.
- Both `--self-test`s stay green, with no floor change. Add one case to fleet-roster that pins the imported identity (`LEDGER_EXCLUSION === mailbox-open's`).

## Acceptance

- `git grep -n "'pm:mailbox'" scripts/pm` → one declaration site (`mailbox-open.mjs`), plus `ensure-pm-labels.sh`.
- `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` and `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` exit 0.

## Work estimate

Lane `domain:devx` · 1 PR (`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs`) · Size S · `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` · not governed (ordinary queue landing). Serial: after #25433 merges (`mailbox-open.mjs` must be on `main`).
